reviews.comment: keeps my CPU cool at idle and load. My 5800x3D is nice and cool with this budget. fans that came with it are quiet nicer than i expected honestly, good ram clearance.
reviews.author: Cody J.

reviews.title: ***Great Air Cooler System***
reviews.comment: Great air cooler. Under stress gaming it never goes above 55 Celsius and idles in the 30's. I did order the ARGB model but was sent one without the digital readout. Amazon gave me a $20 credit towards my next purchase rather than replace the one I have. No big deal talking about the temp recorder. I am very happy with this cooler that I used when upgrading from a Ryzen 5 3600 to the Ryzen 7 5800X. I highly recommend this air cooler it really works well and is quiet even when turbo charged for extra cooling benefits. Again HIGHLY RECOMMEND this product.
reviews.author: Sam Moss

reviews.title: Good but it can improve
reviews.comment:
I've been using this cooler for over 3 months now, and it performs very well. I'm running it with an Intel i7 12700KF, and so far I haven't had any temperature issues, even during heavy usage sessions.
The fans are large, it comes with all the necessary accessories, and the installation manual is clear and helpful, making the setup process easy even if you're not very experienced.
The only downside is the ARGB lighting, which looks a bit dim compared to other fans I own—the colors aren't as vibrant or bright. However, this is just a visual detail and doesn’t affect the overall performance.
Overall, it’s a great value for the price, especially if you're looking for a reliable cooling solution for your CPU.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Quality CPU Cooler
reviews.comment: Nice quality, feels sturdy. Mounting it is very straight forward. Both fans are ARGB with standard 5v 3pin header. It does include a fan splitter for power only. I'd buy it again. Temps idled in the high 20s on a i7 6700.
